position.title: Screen Position
position.description: Where to display this module on the mirror screen.

interval.title: Update Interval (Seconds)
interval.description: Time to wait between data refreshes (15 minutes recommended).

provider.title: Weather Provider
provider.description: Select weather provider. SMHI is recommended for the Nordics, Open-Meteo is key-less and global, WeatherAPI and OpenWeather require API keys.

weatherapi_key.title: WeatherAPI.com Key
weatherapi_key.description: API Key for WeatherAPI.com (required if WeatherAPI is selected).

openweathermap_key.title: OpenWeatherMap Key
openweathermap_key.description: API Key for OpenWeatherMap (required if OpenWeatherMap is selected).

forecast_days.title: Forecast Days
forecast_days.description: Number of days to show in the daily forecast.

forecast_type.title: Forecast Type
forecast_type.description: Select forecast data: daily (upcoming days), hourly (upcoming hours), or combined (both today's hours and upcoming days).

layout.title: Layout Style
layout.description: Select the visual style: horizontal (wider grid timeline/columns) or vertical (original list/rows).

forecast_hours.title: Forecast Hours
forecast_hours.description: Number of hours to show in the hourly timeline.
